questions.de: Auf etwa das Wievielfache der ursprünglich geplanten Summe stiegen die Baukosten für die Hamburger Elbphilharmonie bis zu ihrer Fertigstellung?
questions.en: Roughly how many times the originally planned sum did the construction costs of Hamburg's Elbphilharmonie rise to by its completion?

timeline.labelEn: Opening ceremony of the Elbphilharmonie concert hall in Hamburg

questions.notes: Card offered double / fivefold / tenfold. Wikipedia: final cost about 866 million euros, more than eleven times the originally planned 77 million; 'tenfold' is the card's intended (closest) option.

timeline.labelEn: Winter Olympics held in the same year as the Summer Games
timeline.labelDe: Olympische Winterspiele finden im selben Jahr wie die Sommerspiele statt

questions.notes: The card's statement ('bis 1996') is false: the last shared year was 1992; since Lillehammer 1994 the Winter Games alternate two years apart from the Summer Games.
